rebuild.scope: Path-limited O32-MN08 owned-file patch; no unrelated old-lane files copied.

bookingProjection: Retains the existing list arguments, columns, search/status filters, limit and paid_paise calculation.
Adds separately labelled customer cash, applied coins, demo capture, refund-state buckets and net_held_paise from public._net_paid.
Aggregates each payment's refund states laterally to avoid sibling-row multiplication.
problemMoney: Refund and transfer JSON carry supported service/sports/pack parent IDs.
Transfer diagnostics include processing_started_at, rail and gateway_status.
Problem payouts include processing transfers at least 30 minutes old even without last_error while preserving failed/error rows.
views: Booking and payout routes are thin exports to their owned moneyScreens hosts.
Booking, refund and payout views display funding, refund-attempt and transfer-parent diagnostics.
Service parents route to admin booking detail, sports parents to admin sports administration, and pack parents remain explicitly labelled without being routed as services.
Payout retry eligibility remains failed-parent plus failed-child only.

money.finding: After a full-refund failure, payment status remains refund_pending and the mandated existing _net_paid projection reports zero.
money.rationale: Captured cash and refund-state buckets remain separate from the protected _net_paid semantics; changing net_held_paise would violate the stage contract.
